automationNotes: Single flow for the [end-to-end A/B guide](https://www.contentstack.com/docs/personalize/get-started-with-personalize-with-ab-test-end-to-end-guide). **Doc-minimal:** steps match guide wording only (no **`create-ab-test-experience`**-extra verifies during **initial** A/B draft where the guide omits them). **Runnable order:** §1 project → §5 event → §3 draft (Equally split + two variants + **Save Draft**) → §6 add metric → **§7 Create Entry Variants in CMS** (App Switcher → **Headless CMS** → **`DEFAULT_STACK`** → Settings → **Variants** → link CT → **Entries** / **Base Entries** → edit/save → publish) → §8 activate. **`warn`** = §2 SDK, §4 Live Preview/VB, §9 analytics, §10 Clearwinner. Stack: **`DEFAULT_STACK`** (same as Personalize project). Experience / variant group row: **`PERSONALIZE_E2E_AB_GUIDE_EXPERIENCE_ROW_CONTAINS`** (default **Headline Test**). CMS steps assume at least one content type can be linked and at least one base entry exists.
